settings.training_response: second through final training year for every model
settings.optimizer: L-BFGS-B training conditional likelihood; deterministic multiple starts; exact nested candidates
settings.failure_policy: Exclude failed optimizer starts, retain explicit successful nested candidate; never omit forecast cases. Finite local search gives no global optimum guarantee.
settings.prediction: Normalized retained path PMF; adaptive cap uses past data only, analytic bounds, mean, RPS at fixed reference count zero, and quantile cap-doubling checks. Bounds apply in exact arithmetic; reported roundoff mass discrepancy measures floating point normalization drift, not a certified rounding bound.
settings.rps: sum over nonnegative integers of squared CDF minus observation-step difference, normalized PMF
settings.alpha_zero: exact Poisson candidate; positive optimizer alpha lower bound 1e-8
